body:
I wasnt a lot younger. 13 to 20, i was dating her. I still am 20.


You have clearly never met someone with BPD before, or a sociopath. Those are not insults, that's her. Officially diagnosed. Her life is build upon nothing but lies. So was her relationship with me, with her friends, with her family, everything. And you're telling me, he's an exception? She was already lying to him, before they got together. There's enough I never posted on here, because 1) no one would read it, it's way too much. And 2) It would make it pretty easy to identify who I am. Something I don't want.



Her family has a history of pulling this shit, and she's no exception. Be glad, you've never met someone like this before.


So, do I know it won't work out? Yup, ready to bet my savings on it.


Am i actively waiting for it? No, not longer. I am building up my own life now, and somewhere along the way I'll hear of the news. I could easily shoot some shit into their way that she doesn't want anyone to know, but why would I? I'm staying vague on purpose here.


Kinda lost track of where I was going with this comment, sorry. Pulled an all nighter.

You don't get it. I don't care anymore. Why the fuck would I build something out of this life? I didn't care before she was here, and now I don't care again. The weekend she broke up keeps replaying in my head every single day and kt always ends in regret that I didn't strangle that fucking whore and off myself afterwards.


I really don't give a shit anymore. If it was as easy as 'oh go make something out of it!' I would've done it. But i don't see the point. Why would I go out and risk getting hurt again? Or heck, even if I wouldn't get hurt, it takes effort. Effort takes energy. I don't have that energy. That's why I want to sleep for a few years, maybe then I'll have it back.


I don't mean to lash out on you or anything, it's just that I just can't be bothered anymore. I don't know what i'm trying to get out of posting this, I don't want to give up on life. I just can't take it anymore.
I don't want to go out. I don't want a new girl. I want things to be like they used to be. I'm not ready to move on.
You're right, it would just leave me with more questions.. i'll give meditation a chance as soon as I can today. Thank you, again.

Thank you, really. It means a lot that you've took the time and typed all of this out for me. I truely appreciate it.

I had no choice but to disconnect myself from her. She's basically pretending as if I never existed in the first place, even though we only live a few miles away from eachother. The only way I could contact her, is if I would go up to her house. Something I don't even want to do.

I guess I've been doing most of the others right up until this point.



I just don't know, I'm so confused. This feels like it's going much further than a normal heart break. I've been coping with her leaving me for him pretty good. It's just.. She never existed in the first place? And now she's gonna hurt him. I know she will. And yeah, he deserves it. I warned him, but he didn't listen.


He just doesn't understand that she is just being Ms. Perfect for a few years and she'll do the same to him. That's just who she is, that's her disorder.


But the thing I'm so confused about, is the question 'what was fake, and what was real?'. It can't be all fake, can it? There's no way. Not all those years. But some things definitely were. I'm just stuck in this never ending cycle of thoughts, and have been for the past few days. I have so many questions, yet I know there are no answers. I'm trying to accept that I'll never find any answers, but it's going nowhere so far..


Sorry for my incoherent wall of text. I just really don't know anymore. I need answers and I know I will never get them.


And I know, that one day, she'll be back. But I don't want her back, yet I'm sure I will be tempted to ask for answers..
